remarks: Welcome to the esteemed Compo Commons neighborhood, where this superbly appointed home awaits its next fortunate owner. This exquisitely crafted residence offers unparalleled luxury and convenience, located just a stone's throw from Westport's town center and various amenities, including Compo Beach, Levitt Pavilion, and superb dining spots. This newly renovated, impeccably maintained 5-bedroom, 3 full and 2 half bath home sits on a privately fenced 1/2-acre oasis. It features a beautifully manicured, professionally landscaped property with a heated saltwater gunite pool, spillover spa, bluestone patio, outdoor kitchen, stone fireplace, outdoor shower, and changing room. Inside, the gourmet kitchen boasts top-of-the-line luxury appliances, ample counter space, and custom cabinetry, seamlessly flowing into a spacious family room with a built-in fireplace. The primary bedroom suite includes its own fireplace, custom walk-in closets, and vaulted ceilings, while other bedrooms and bathrooms offer comfort and modernity. Additional features include a spacious two-car garage with high-speed EV charging, an indoor and outdoor custom sound system, city sewer, water, and natural gas. This remarkable property is not just move-in ready; it embodies gracious living with sophistication, comfort, and modern convenience. Don't miss the chance to experience luxury living in Westport.
